title: Google sign-in return: dispatch apricity:auth-changed after the OAuth redirect
description: After a Google redirect the header re-reads the account on page load but no apricity:auth-changed event fires, so Library/Score pick up the session only on reload. Also: import needs both admins and curators groups; postConfirmation only adds new users to members (first admin added by hand, see design/storage.md).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-09-25 fixed (Amplify jobs 19, 21): watchAuth() listens for Amplify Hub auth events before configure and holds view rendering until the Google code exchange finishes; every session event dispatches apricity:auth-changed. Also: account label never shows a raw provider id (displayName), account control moved bottom-left, Library/Score tell signed-out / no-access / empty apart. Found while debugging: (1) users in a Cognito group get THAT group's IAM role, so members/curators need explicit read rules in web/amplify/storage/resource.ts; (2) a more specific storage path (files/hero/*) REPLACES the broader grant and Amplify writes an explicit Deny for roles it does not list, so signed-in roles were denied the hero files that guests could read. Verified: group role policies have 0 Deny statements. Unverified end to end: a signed-in Library read and the import (needs the owner to sign out and in again to pick up the new groups).
